text: おいぼれた　いまは　ポケモンも　３びき　しか　のこっとらんが　おまえに　１ぴき　やろう！

structure.jp: おいぼれた　いまは
structure.en: now that I've grown old and feeble

structure.jp: ポケモンも　３びき　しか　のこっとらんが
structure.en: only three Pokémon are left, but

structure.jp: おまえに　１ぴき　やろう！

patterns.name: 〜しか〜ない
patterns.span: ３びき　しか　のこっとらん
patterns.explanation: しか with a 'not' verb means 'only', nothing more than that. のこっとらん is the old-man way of saying のこっていない. ３びき　しか　のこっとらん = 'only three are left'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a sentence part means 'but'. のこっとらんが = 'there aren't any more left, but'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The おう ending says 'I'll' or 'let's'. やろう = 'I'll give'.
